verdict.rationale: Filee's own documentation says it works offline and uploads nothing, so user files never leave the computer and cannot reach any AI training pipeline. That keeps the data out of training by design, but there is no explicit statement or policy about AI training. missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training policy or statement, telemetry/data-collection disclosure, independent corroboration of the offline claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Nothing is uploaded. Filee works offline, so private documents, photos and recordings never leave your computer.
Filee is a free, open-source (MIT) file converter for Windows 10 and 11 and Linux (macOS preview).
